question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Sacred
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sacred"** means something that is considered holy and deserving of special respect. (पवित्र)

 
 
• **Example: **The temple is a **sacred** place for the community.
 
 
 
• **"Profane"** refers to something that is not sacred or religious; it is often associated with showing disrespect towards sacred things. (अपवित्र)
 
 
• **Example: **The graffiti on the church walls was considered **profane** by the locals.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'sacred'** is **'profane'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Grave** (गंभीर): Something serious or solemn.

 
 
• **Example:** The situation was** grave**, and immediate action was required.
 
 
 
• **Narrow** (संकीर्ण): Limited in extent, amount, or scope.
 
 
• **Example:** The **narrow** alley was difficult to navigate.
 
 
 
• **Holy** (पवित्र): Dedicated or consecrated to God or a religious purpose; sacred.
 
 
• **Example:** The **holy **scriptures are revered by followers.
